svg.title: d1-3B: time to answer one question at 101 input tokens
svg.desc: RTX 5080 Laptop: ONNX Runtime GenAI on CUDA, fp16: 18.4 ms. Intel GPU: static graph of 128 tokens, int8 weights: 50.3 ms. Intel NPU: static graph of 128 tokens, OpenVINO EP: 54.2 ms. CPU: ONNX Runtime GenAI with the OpenVINO EP, int8, CPU pinning: 561 ms.
svg.text: d1-3B: time to answer one question at 101 input tokens
Milliseconds on the fastest setup of each processor, one laptop. Shorter is faster.
RTX 5080 Laptop: ONNX Runtime GenAI on CUDA, fp16
Intel GPU: static graph of 128 tokens, int8 weights
Intel NPU: static graph of 128 tokens, OpenVINO EP
